bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9. JOIKA must be forgiven for an unplaced latest effort at Newcastle when there were excuses on the day. THE CRISTAL has continued to maintain consistency as her five start current preparation has progressed and she can be expected to maintain that consistency when she attempts a significant distance rise today. ROYAL PRINCESS handed in a most acceptable front-running effort at Newcastle last start with Izzy Neale aboard. She has now been produced twice in blinkers and she has done enough on both occasions to be greatly respected here. TSAREVICH wasn't disgraced after gear changes were made when she was making her Scone debut last start. She will now have scope to improve when she presents third up.

raceTips.comment: Joika was a little disappointing on face value last time but found the line well the start prior and is seemingly screaming out for a distance like this. Quirky Princess appeals at the odds after really warming up to/through the line last time. Fitter/further suits. Royal Princess will likely park on speed and will be awarded every chance. The Cristal is unknown at this distance range but should she run it out she is deservedly at the top end of the market.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11. SUMMER FORCE struck traffic problems before she kept trying in defeat here at home on debut. Natural improvement can now be expected when she tackles a very suitable distance rise from 1100m. TASMAN DEEL presents on debut at his home base. He was spelled after his trial here in March. Two much more recent trials have him primed to cope with this journey at his first start. MALAY PENINSULA handed in an honest debut effort at Gunnedah and stepping up from 1000m already aids his cause. MAY THE FORCE was resuming when she performed well above market place expectations here at home over this distance last start. Her race was conducted one month ago but even so, she can be expected to at least maintain her form today.

raceTips.comment: Summer Force was solid on debut in what looks a handy enough form reference race relative to this. The rise in distance looks ideal, as does Jean Van Overmeire sticking aboard. Tasman Deel has shown enough at the trials so has deservedly been kept very safe in betting. Malay Peninsula did enough on debut and looks suited over further. May The Force had absolutely no market expectation when resuming but was solid enough after racing on speed. Freshened since, there is upside.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 8, 9. HEATHCLIFF finished unplaced at Gunnedah when he stepped up to tackle this distance for the first time. Blinkers have immediately been added to his gear and he can atone for that defeat at short odds when he now returns to his home base. SUPREME STATEMENT shouldn't be harshly judged for an unplaced second up Newcastle effort. He did keep trying in a race that wasn't run to suit him. STREET FORCE opened her account first up at Gunnedah and taking the next step will not be beyond here when she now makes a home track debut. FAMAHAN was produced second up at Moree when he performed above market place expectations on the day. He is already proven here over this distance and he should not be underestimated today.

raceTips.comment: Time To Commit has been rock solid in both runs since breaking maiden status and appeals at the price. Winkers go on, where she settles in running is key. Heathcliff stepped up to this trip last time out and was only sound when well supported. Blinkers go on and there has been strong early market support again. Street Force is progressive enough to measure up in this grade after a last start maiden win. Famahan worked home well last time and should be peaking now.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9. PUNXSUTAWNEY PHIL and LUCAND MAGIC both present on debut in a race that is "winnable" for a first starter. They have both trialed twice since a spell and this journey should not be an issue for either three-year-old at their first start. MR HUGO was produced on debut when he struck a traffic problem here at home over this trip last start. He kept trying and natural improvement can now be expected. YEAH BUDDY was resuming here last start when he stuck to his task first up and at his first outing since a stable change. He can play a part at home today second up without causing a surprise. RAGUEL was anything but disgraced second up at Taree before excuses were offered for his defeat on the day!

raceTips.comment: Punxsutawney Phil has shown plenty of ability in numerous trial heats so I'm not surprised to see heavy early market support. We have to take the short odds now, but he looks a colt with a stack of upside. Yeah Buddy is the model of minor money consistency and looks a lock to follow that trend at very least. Mr Hugo comes via the same race and it was a solid debut. Will have derived good benefit from the experience. Warshade resumes for a second prep gelded and has scope to improve.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 3, 4, 8. MAGIC MERLIN presents in search of a hat-trick. He was dominant when he returned to his home base her within this distance range last start and he can continue on his winning way this afternoon. FAN HARDER is another who returns to his home track today and he should not be harshly judged for recent Rosehill outings when he will be more suitably placed today. BELLEVUE was competing in a race that wasn't run to suit him at Kembla Grange last start when his unplaced effort was better than it appears at face value. KING JERRY had too much to do from a wide gate at Rosehill last start. He will have scope to improve after drawing a much kinder barrier today.

raceTips.comment: King Jerry and Fan Harder come via the same Highway race and that looks the right form line for this. In said race they all but finished alongside each other so are hard to split. With the weight swing heavily favouring King Jerry, that's the way I'll lean. Magic Merlin is chasing a hat-trick and there is really nothing to suggest he can't do so. Super Sugoi next.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 5, 6, 12. HERMAN SAID will appreciate a quicker back-up and a drop in class after finishing unplaced last start at Newcastle. He has scope to improve here, third up. KING POTTER trialed twice in August and he will be making his home track debut when he resumes from a long spell after there were problems following a first up Taree win at his lone start in his last campaign. He's ready to make his return to the races today. VIA FLAMINIA is another who presents first up. She's also trialed twice recently and she's more than ready to now make her Scone debut. KAKODA finished unplaced before a post-race issue was detected last start at Randwick. That issue has now been resolved and she can regain her best form when she returns to her home base this afternoon.

raceTips.comment: Kakoda looks well placed back in this grading. Got a mile back in town last time and pulled up with thumps so forgive/forget that effort. Expecting her best here at home. King Potter carries weight but can utilise the inside draw and clearly has upside. Herman Said can improve down in class and should be peaking third up. Myalaby strips fitter second up after a good resuming effort.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 5, 6, 7, 15. AMAJICSTAR led throughout on debut at Newcastle when she found the line with no dangers. She can already take the next step today without causing a surprise. PANTA RHEI conceded all a start before she out-finished all but the winner here third up. Blinkers have now been added to her gear and in her case, stepping back in distance from 1200m should not be regarded today as a minus with the gear change made. NEVERMISTA can be given the chance to atone for his defeat here at home last start when there were excuses over this journey. CASSIERE presents first up after a recent Muswellbrook trial when Mitchell Bell was aboard. Mitchell has retained the ride today at what will be a first attempt since a stable change and this race is within her reach!

raceTips.comment: Haney looks well placed dropping back in grade, sets up as the map horse of the race and again gets good weight relief with a 4kg claimer on. Amajicstar impressed winning on debut and profiles like the type that can measure up and do it again. Nevermista always races well here, just might need some luck early from a tricky gate. Cassiere resumes off a long spell but sparks interest on prior form.
